_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for how ClearStreak literature content is organized and labeled.
rules: Fidelity over brevity: reading_time is metadata for surfacing, never a reason to trim a message.
12 Steps are verbatim, never mined, never labeled as passages.
Every passage must carry: >=1 moment, exactly 1 stage, exactly 1 function, halt, urge_level, applies_to, reading_time, source, needs_clinical_review.
_meta.scope_v1: Mine Tier 1 fully (Doctor's Opinion + Ch I-VII + XI) and Tier 2 selectively (Ch VIII-X, universal nuggets only). The 29 personal stories are DROPPED for v1 (rewriting testimony destroys authenticity); revisit with real modern voices post-launch. The persona axis was removed with the stories.

layers.reader: big_book.json — the 42 ordered sections (front/main/stories). Full read experience, reader_text fidelity.
layers.passages: passages file — mined moment-of-need units. Each has reader_text + surface_text + labels + provenance, and points back to reader via source{chapter_id,page,paragraph_index}.

applies_to.note: UNIVERSAL = message is substance-agnostic (resentment, fear, hope). Alcohol-specific wording => [ALCOHOL].

moment.role: PRIMARY ROUTER — why surface this now. Derived from the user's live state (halt tap + urge tier).

values.desc: Self-recognition; am I actually an alcoholic/addict
Service, purpose, staying sober by helping
Feeling hopeless / needs hope (routes with HALT HOPELESS)

reading_time.role: Surfacing hint ONLY. quick<=~15 sentences. Never used to shorten a message.

routing._desc: Default map from live app state (urge_level x halt) -> candidate moments. App picks passages whose labels intersect. CRITICAL routes to Crisis Intercept first; a quick grounding passage is optional secondary.

CRITICAL._note: Crisis Intercept is primary; passage is optional + must be reading_time=quick
